title: Design: Bulk change success message looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 4.5 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click the part B row.
  6. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  7. Click "Deactivate" in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The dark bar appears.

Step 4:

  • Part A is ticked.

Step 5:

  • Part B is ticked and the badge reads 2.

Step 6:

  • The "Deactivate parts?" confirmation opens.

Step 7:

  • A green message box appears with a white tick-in-a-circle icon at its left, the words "2 parts updated." and "Close" at its right.
  • The message box sits at the bottom right of the page.
  • The dark bar and the checkbox column are gone.
  • The search text is still in the Search box, and parts A and B are no longer listed on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S10-R12: “After a bulk change, the system shows how many parts changed and how many failed.”
  • S2-R12: “The deactivated parts leave the Active tab without a page reload.”
  • S2-R14: “When every ticked part changes, the mode ends and the selection clears.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Bulk change, every part changed | "{n} parts updated." ("1 part updated." for one) | Success toast, fades on its own”
